title: Multimarginal flow matching with optimal transport potentials
tldr_zh: 把逐段CFM的中间边缘硬约束松弛为动态OT作用量中的软势能项，得到simulation-free多边缘FM，并给出势强度—Wasserstein偏差界
tldr_en: Relaxes piecewise CFM hard marginal constraints into soft potential terms in the dynamic OT action, yielding simulation-free multimarginal FM with Wasserstein alignment bounds
